title: Abbas Mere Bhai
body:
Abbas mere bhai, Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalte huwe khaimou se Zainab ki sada aayi
Badhke huwe sholey hai gham ki hai ghata chayi
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai, Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jal jane ka saa'man hai yeh sham e ghariba hai
Yeh sham e ghariba hai jal jane ka saa'man hai
Is waqt na aaye toh kab aaouge aye bhai
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kya soote ho sahil per mou-mood kr Zainab se
Mou-mood ke Zainab ss kya soote ho sahil per
Imdad ko khahir ki aate nahin kyun bhai
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Be-gooro kafan ran mein maajaye ka lasha hai
Maajaye ka lasha hai be-gooro kafan ran mein
Jalte huwe khaimou mein bechain hai maajayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bazoo mein rasan hogi be parda bahen hogi
Beparda bahen hogi bazoo mein rasan hogi
Kya tumko gawaara hai Zainab ki yeh ruswayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Pyasou ki khaber lene laut e nahin darya se
Laut e nahin darya se pyasou ki khaber lene
Kya baat huwi akhir karte nahin saqqayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jalta hai mera sub ghar chen'ti hai meri chader
Chen'ti hai meri chadar jalta hai mera sub ghar
Karbal ki faza bhaiyya Zainab ko na raas aayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tadpaati nahi dil ko kya yaad Sakina ki
Kya yaad Sakina ki tadpaati nahi dil ko
Khaati hai tamache ab yeh aap ki shaidayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Imdad ko Zainab ki Abbas nahi aaye
Abbas nahi aaye imdad ko Zainab ki
Roo rooke Hassan har dum kehti rahi dukhpayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas mere bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz..hasan abedi
